findings.headline: Runs nearly as hard overnight as during occupied hours
findings.action: Check time schedules in the building management system, and whether AHUs and lighting circuits are set to switch off out of hours.
findings.would_rule_out: Expected for a data centre, 24-hour clinic or a building with freezers or continuous process load.

findings.headline: Little or no weekend setback
findings.action: Check that the weekend schedule differs from the weekday one, and that holiday calendars are configured.
findings.would_rule_out: Expected where the building genuinely operates seven days a week.

summary: Runs nearly as hard overnight as during occupied hours
caveat: Hypotheses to check on site, not conclusions. Each finding lists what would explain it legitimately.
